name: mobidrop_mobicube
description: MobiDrop/MobiCube single-cell 3' RNA-seq processed by MobiVision. Public FASTQs generally require MobiDrop-specific barcode whitelist correction and preprocessing before STAR-based mapping.
notes: UniScFlow downloads and records platform inference for MobiCube/MobiVision datasets, but stops before automatic read assignment and mapping.
Use MobiDrop/MobiVision documentation or validated platform-specific preprocessing resources to extract barcode/UMI information before downstream alignment.

halt_guidance.blocker: MobiDrop/MobiCube data require MobiVision-compatible chemistry, barcode correction resources, and a matching MobiVision reference index.
required_inputs: MobiDrop/MobiCube chemistry version and matching MobiVision software/resources
next_steps: Confirm the MobiDrop/MobiCube kit version and library type.
Build or obtain the matching MobiVision reference index.
Run MobiVision quantify and preserve the exact command, software version, and validated matrix.
halt_guidance.resume: Use the validated MobiVision matrix downstream; UniScFlow does not substitute generic barcode correction.
